Information

Current RbbP version: 1.7.7 (12.09.2026)

This mod is built for MULTIPLAYER games; balance changes are aimed at a comfortable experience against other players.

Victory conditions

Seals Victory

  • Reduced points required

Magic Victory

  • Ancient Wonder ritual spell
    • Available upon unlocking a T3 tome
    • Reduced cast cost
    • Reduced required 1500 -> 250
  • Age of Magic ritual spell
    • Available upon unlocking a T3 tome
    • Reduced cast cost
    • Reduced required 3000 -> 500

Expansion Victory

  • Reduced number of sectors required
  • Reduced build cost of the Unity Beacon
    • 280 750 → 170 450

Realm traits

Umbral Abyss

  • Pickups
    • Guard strength increased: Medium -> Strong
    • Tome Fragment now only unlocks spells from the Tome of {{Eldritch Pact}}
      • {{Summon Umbral Juggernaut}}
      • {{Ritual of the Gloomveil}}
      • {{Pall of Gloom}}
      • {{Umbral Exile}}
      • {{Umbral Rift}}
  • Fixes
    • Umbral resource nodes: rolling back a turn in multiplayer used to duplicate the resource income from these nodes. Chitinous Growths 30 . Monoliths 30

Crystal Dwelling

  • Trade
    • Removed Strategic Artifacts.
    • {{Lithorine Shardlancer}} and {{Lithorine Core}} swapped trade slots.
  • Quests
    • Removed item-crafting quests.
    • Reward for declining a quest reduced 4x.

Shrouded Isles

  • {{Move Portal}} action
    • Can now only target a tile within a province that has a city

(New) Consequences of Defeat

  • Optional realm trait
  • When a player is defeated or surrenders, all cities belonging to them and their vassals are instantly destroyed (no ruins left behind). Exception: cities currently under siege.

Lords

Created leaders

Observer

  • This lord cannot be edited
  • Can be selected in any game (not recommended for scenario/story worlds)
  • Multiple Observers can be selected
  • If AI-controlled, loses at the start of the game
  • Loses their starting city and army at the start (does not lose the game)
  • No additional free city of the same faction appears on the map
  • Not included in random selection
  • Cannot cast spells or rituals
  • All resource income per turn = 0
  • Has no Whispering Stones
  • Receives a one-time resource grant at the start
    • 999999
    • 999999
    • 99999
    • 99999
    • 10 of every magic material
  • Forge functionality is unlocked
  • Cannot declare war/treaty/pact/alliance with players
  • Players cannot declare war/treaty/pact/alliance with the Observer
  • Diplomatic status with other players is permanently neutral
  • Resource and artifact trading is available in diplomacy
  • Can create quests
  • Full map vision is unlocked
  • Sees players' hidden units
  • Does not see hidden neutral units
